skill.name: pdf
skill.description: Work with PDFs locally: extract text and tables, convert pages to images, and merge or split documents. Create PDFs, fill forms, add annotations, and support OCR workflows.
skill.summary: Process, extract, convert, create, and fill PDF documents with local tools.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Reviewed 95 static findings across PDF documentation and helper scripts. The flagged external-command items are Markdown/code-template false positives, and the filesystem items are expected local PDF and JSON outputs with no evidence of network exfiltration, secret harvesting, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to caller-provided output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Check before overwriting existing files and prefer workspace-relative output paths for generated PDFs and JSON files.

remediation.issue: Several workflows rely on external PDF tools or image converters.
remediation.suggestion: Document required binaries clearly and run conversion or repair commands only after the user confirms the files and outputs.

remediation.issue: PDF parsers and image converters may process untrusted documents.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dependencies patched and use a sandboxed environment for PDFs from unknown sources.

content.user_title: Process PDF Files with Local Tools
content.value_statement: PDF tasks often require different tools for extraction, editing, forms, and OCR. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical workflows for local PDF processing.
actual_capabilities: Extract text and tables from searchable PDF files.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, encrypt, and watermark PDFs.
Create new PDFs with text, tables, pages, and simple styling.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual inspection or OCR.
Fill interactive PDF forms and add annotations to flat forms.
Use helper scripts to inspect form fields and validate bounding boxes.
limitations: Some workflows require Python packages or command-line tools already installed.
OCR accuracy depends on scan quality, language, and image resolution.
Flat form filling may need manual coordinate review before final output.
The skill does not recover unknown passwords from encrypted PDFs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Office Document Packets
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, and watermark PDFs for complete client or internal document packets.

use_cases.title: Extract Report Data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, metadata, and page images from reports for review or analysis.

use_cases.title: Complete PDF Forms
use_cases.description: Inspect fillable fields or add annotations to flat forms, then verify the completed document.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Text From A PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from <file.pdf>. Keep page breaks visible and summarize the main points after extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Merge And Organize PDFs
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge these PDF files in order: <files>. Rotate any sideways pages and create one clean output PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Fill A PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Fill <form.pdf> with the provided values. Check whether it has fillable fields, use the correct workflow, and verify placement.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Batch PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Process every PDF in <folder>. Extract text, save page images, report failures, and create a summary of completed files.

output_examples.input: A searchable annual report PDF with tables and several sections.
output_examples.output: Extracted page text, a list of detected tables, and a short summary of each major section.

output_examples.input: Three scanned application pages that need to become one organized packet.
output_examples.output: A merged PDF with corrected page order, rotated pages, and preview images for visual verification.

output_examples.input: A flat PDF form plus names, dates, and checkbox selections.
output_examples.output: A filled PDF with annotations placed in the requested fields and a verification checklist.

best_practices: Keep original PDFs unchanged and write results to clearly named output files.
Verify form fields and bounding boxes before creating the final filled PDF.
Use OCR only when text extraction from the PDF layer fails.
anti_patterns: Do not run repair or conversion commands on untrusted files without user approval.
Do not assume scanned PDFs contain selectable text.
Do not overwrite source documents with generated outputs.

faq.question: Can this skill read scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide OCR workflows when a PDF page is image-based.

faq.question: Can it fill interactive PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes, helper scripts can inspect fields, validate values, and write a filled PDF.

faq.question: Can it fill forms without PDF form fields?
faq.answer: Yes, it can add text annotations by using extracted or visually estimated coordinates.

faq.question: Does it need external software?
faq.answer: Some tasks need packages such as pypdf, pdfplumber, pdf2image, Tesseract, qpdf, or poppler tools.

faq.question: Can it remove a PDF password?
faq.answer: It can decrypt a PDF only when the correct password is available.

faq.question: Does it send PDF content to a network service?
faq.answer: No network workflow is shown in the skill files. Processing is described as local file operations.
